name: KENTUCKY ROOK
description: Rook variant for four in fixed partnerships. 45 cards (2s-4s removed). Bid from 100 in multiples of 5, take nest, discard five (no point cards), name trump. Trick play; Rook highest trump; 180 points per deal. First team to 500 wins.

content.text: Rook variant for four in fixed partnerships. 45 cards (2s-4s removed). Bid from 100 in multiples of 5, take nest, discard five (no point cards), name trump. Trick play; Rook highest trump; 180 points per deal. First team to 500 wins.
Kentucky Rook derives from Rook (published 1906 by Parker Brothers). Popular in Eastern Kentucky; rules from contributor John Hay.
Rook deck with 2s, 3s, 4s removed (45 cards including Rook)
Ten cards each, one at a time; five cards to the nest. Dealer adds one card to the nest after each of the first five rounds.

items.text: Rook as lowest trump: Some play with the Rook as the lowest card of the trump color rather than the highest.
Point cards in nest: Some allow the bidder to discard point cards; points in the nest go to the team that wins the last trick.
Kentucky Discard: Official Rook Tournament variant: 41 cards (ones omitted), 9 each and 5 nest, dealer bids first, min bid 70, count cards may be discarded, game to 300.
